color_distribution.basis: Reuse the existing fixed continuous histogram operator: a one-level RGB movement across a hard bin boundary must not masquerade as a large style regression. Raw hard-bin TV remains separately reported; DeltaE and RGB error are additional independent checks.

basis: Engineering defaults for displayed editable illustrations, frozen before construction and validated with vector, blurred, ringing and granular independent controls. Edge-spread methodology is inspired by ESF; this is not ISO 12233 certification. Material residual applies only to explicitly smooth original regions, not texture/noise/data.
